description: Renames a burst and answers it, and with renameVariants its reports too. Only the burst's owner and admins may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

renameFiles.description: For a burst of Google Slides, Google Docs, PowerPoint or Word reports: whether to also rename the burst's folders, and with `renameVariants` each report's file, in Google Drive or OneDrive. It goes on after the answer. Defaults to `false`.

renameVariants.description: Whether to rename every report in the burst after the new name too, as `variantNaming` builds each name, the template included. A Rollstack report's burst renames the template, which is the report the burst was made from. Defaults to `false`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: renameBurst
title: Rename burst
